projects.name: aimdb [contributor]
projects.summary: aimdb establishes format for data transfer over the network (from a microcontroller via an edge device to a browser) as Rust types used across the network devices running different asynchronous engines. My contribution has been reworking the implementation of synchronous interface used by async-oblivious code. In the process, I have identified and fixed multiple issues (besides the original one) in existing codebase, receiving 'Thanks a lot for your detailed analysis!!!' from the maintainer.
